name: Portalito
description: Live TV and VOD from a configurable IPTV portal.
overview: Live TV channels and VOD movies/series from a configurable IPTV portal, played through an in-plugin re-signing proxy.

versions.changelog: Destacado rows are listed best-rated first instead of A–Z. TMDB rows use TMDB's rating (from 10 votes up), else the portal's; unrated titles go last. Another order picked in the app's sort menu still applies. New setting SortFeaturedByRating (on by default) turns it off.

The rest of the 2026-10-02 code review. Each series is one item in Jellyfin. A show's folder was named after whichever season a listing happened to show first, so the same show appeared as several series, and the old one was deleted with its seasons when a newer season took the lead. Shows are now…

Fixes from a code review. "Siguiendo" keeps your progress if a show is renamed. Jellyfin tied a show's watch history to its folder, and the folder follows the show's name; each show now carries a stable id that Jellyfin keys the history by. "Siguiendo" series are hidden from users who can't open…

The channel gets the Portalito logo on its own. Jellyfin only asks a channel for its images when it first creates it, so a server that had the channel before 0.1.0.8 never got the logo without a manual "Refresh metadata". A new task, "Logo del canal Portalito" (at startup and weekly), fills in…

Each Destacado row shows its own picture again. Rows were identified by their position in the list, so adding rows (like 0.1.1.3's platform rows) gave the rows after them the position, and the picture Jellyfin had stored, of another row: Disney+ showed "Películas de anime", HBO showed "Series…

Destacado rows by streaming platform. Six new default rows list each platform's own series, most popular first, keeping only what your portal has: Originales Netflix, Apple TV+, Disney+, HBO, Prime Video and Paramount+. Measured on a test server: 34 to 60 playable series per row. New row options…

Subtitles in "Next Up" episodes. Episodes played from the hidden "Portalito · Siguiendo" library now offer the portal's subtitle files (e.g. Spanish and English), like the channel does. They're fetched the first time an episode is played. A series you're watching no longer drops out of…

Resuming or jumping into the middle of a movie or episode no longer fails at random. To seek, Jellyfin's ffmpeg makes 20-30 quick requests, each opening a new connection to the portal's CDN; when one of them took longer than 4 seconds to connect, the seek failed and playback stopped with an error…

Portalito series now show up in Jellyfin's "Next Up". Jellyfin builds Next Up only from libraries, never from channels, so the plugin now keeps a library called "Portalito · Siguiendo" with just the series people are watching (played in the last 60 days, or marked favorite), not the whole catalog.…

Movies and episodes now show up in Jellyfin's "Continue Watching" and resume where you left off. Jellyfin only keeps a playback position when it knows a title's length; Portalito never told it, so Jellyfin marked everything as watched the moment it started. The plugin now gives each title its…

A logo for the channel. "Portalito VOD" now shows the Portalito logo (a lit doorway with a play button) instead of a blank tile: the square logo as its main image, a banner as its thumb and backdrop. They're built in, so they work even before the portal is configured. The plugin also shows the…
Recommended. Fix: switching a setting back to an earlier value now relists correctly (0.1.0.6's cache key could reuse a stale listing).
Fix: setting changes show in the next listing (no 3-hour wait); installs from 0.1.0.4 get the default Destacado rows. Update to 0.1.0.7.
New: 11 default Destacado rows (Tendencias, Estrenos, Series coreanas, Anime JP/KR...), active once a TMDB key is set. Update to 0.1.0.7.
New: Destacado rows from TMDB lists (trending, popular, discover by country/genre...), showing only titles your portal has. Needs a TMDB key.
New: leave Device SN blank and the plugin registers its own free-tier device (and re-registers an expired one). New optional snToken salt setting.
New: Import / export box on the config page - paste a .env or JSON to fill every field, export to copy settings to another server.
First working release: VOD channel (Destacado, Descubrir, TV en vivo), Live TV with guide, re-signing proxy, TMDB enrichment, collages. Built for any Jellyfin 10.11.x.
